summary: DAHLS MEKANISKE (org. no. 931 403 648) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Aure, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2023-05-13. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 33.120 (Reparasjon og vedlikehold av maskiner); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2023 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 54 560 and net income was NOK 27 409.
